cuts.head: turn_side
cuts.ofreeRecent: the central atrium of a space station — carries her keepsake low at her side; a quiet modern apartment window seat at night — she settles down to watch a film with a bowl of popcorn; a modern outdoor model-sailboat pond beside a bright white promenade in late morning — she enjoys steering a tiny remote-controlled sailboat around a buoy; the open deck of a wooden sightseeing boat on the Yangtze — rests the pen from a notebook against her lips; a cedar-wood tub by the window of a mountain inn — chest-deep in the water; a stage under a painted night sky of crystal stars — kneeling on the ground; a hydroponic bathing pool aboard a starship — standing with one foot up on a step; a rocky waterfall pool under green trees — swimming freestyle at an easy pace; a domed marble hammam with warm stone slabs and brass bowls — standing and leaning her upper body forward toward the camera from the hips; a scholar's study stacked with bound bamboo slips — lifts a small storage box onto the shelf above her; a stage under a painted night sky of crystal stars — standing; a lantern-lit old-town street at night — standing; a Peking opera dressing room — standing at a work surface
